collection.description: The healers' hut is a mess.

ask.text:
The healers' hut is a mess. (healer) has been sick for a week, and nobody else knows where anything is. (friend) has a fever and a cough that rattles, and (subject) has been sent to find the jar of blue root powder that (healer) always uses for it.
There are two jars on the shelf with blue powder in them. One is labelled with a fish. One is labelled with a bird. (healer), asked from (subject.his/her) mat, waves a hand and says, "The fish. No. The bird. Which one has the chip in the lid?" Neither has a chip in the lid.
Which jar should (subject) use?

c1o1.text: It's the right one. By morning the fever is down and the cough has stopped rattling. (subject) labels the fish jar "COUGH" in big letters, and the bird jar "NOT COUGH," and then spends a week tidying the whole hut and labelling everything, which (healer), when (subject.he/she) gets up, says (subject.he/she) will never be able to find anything in again.

c1o2.text: The fish jar, it turns out, is not medicine at all. It's the dye the weavers use for the {@chief}'s robe. (friend)'s cough gets better on its own over the week, but (friend) is bright blue from head to foot, and stays that way for a season. "That's for cloth," says (healer), weakly, from (subject.his/her) mat.

c1.text: (subject) mixes the blue powder from the fish jar with water and gives it to (friend), who drinks it, and makes a face like someone eating a lemon, and lies back...

c2o1.text: (friend) sleeps for two days straight. The healers take turns watching (friend.him/her) breathe. When (friend.he/she) wakes up, the fever is gone and the cough with it, and (friend.he/she) says it was the best sleep of (friend.his/her) life. The bird jar is sleeping powder. (healer) says that works too, sometimes.

c2o2.text: The bird jar works, but it isn't the healers'. It belongs to the researchers, who have been grinding a rare blue stone for a year to study it, and (subject) has just used the last of it. (friend) is cured. The researchers' year of work is gone.

c2.text: (subject) mixes the powder from the bird jar and gives it to (friend), who drinks it, coughs, and then goes very quiet...
